items.q: Ray Nance had a band that to me was just as great as John Kirby's Turbey's.

ctx.x: Dave Young was -- was a fine saxophone player. And, of course, (inaudible) you know at that time Ray Nance had a band that to me was just as great as John Kirby's Turbey's.
